title: Baki: The Great Raitai Tournament Saga
synopsis: Granted special entry into the Great Raitai Tournament, a poisoned Baki now faces fighters in China, where the next true Sea Emperor will be chosen. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Begin! The Centennial Tournament
episodes.synopsis: Mohammad Alai Jr. tests a battle-eager Yujiro. Even though he's been poisoned, Sea King Retsu enters Baki into the Great Raitai Tournament in China. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Turnaround
episodes.synopsis: Alai Jr.'s deadly speed makes quick work of his opponent. A severely emaciated Baki faces Sea King Li, the greatest Poison Hand user in all of China. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Revived!
episodes.synopsis: Sea Emperor Kaku is 121 years older than his opponent, but the legendary reigning champion doesn't hesitate to face Sea King Samwan in the arena. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Team Formed!
episodes.synopsis: Sea King Chin and Japan's sole Sea King, Jaku battle on the tournament floor. Meanwhile, Baki provokes Yujiro into fighting him offstage. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Hand Pocket
episodes.synopsis: Biscuit Oliva's sheer power is unrivaled, but Shobun Ron and his unconventional fighting stance are unbothered. It's brute strength versus iai kenpo. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Excellennnnt!
episodes.synopsis: A genius of Chinese kenpo, Retsu is the superior fighter, but Jaku's dirty techniques and tactical prowess make him a formidable foe. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Kaioh
episodes.synopsis: Sea Emperor Kaku is the embodiment of Chinese kenpo. Yujiro is known as the strongest creature on Earth. A battle unlike any other begins! (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Title of the Strongest
episodes.synopsis: Yujiro pits his raw power against Kaku's martial arts skills, which he's honed for over a century. The match's shocking outcome stuns everyone. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: The Master vs the Boxer
episodes.synopsis: Alai Jr. propose to Kozue, who's dumbfounded. To prove he's a better man than Baki, Alai Jr. challenges the elderly aikido master Goki Shibukawa. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Stand and Fight
episodes.synopsis: Alai Jr. continues testing his skill against notable fighters, but Baki's half-brother Jack Hanma is unlike any combatant he's faced before. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.synopsis: Badly injured from his street fights, Alai Jr. returns to his hotel room. There his father, the greatest boxer of all time, challenges him to a match. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Competition
episodes.synopsis: A battle between the sons of two legendary fighters begins deep below Tokyo Dome. It's Baki versus Alai Jr., and the winner is anyone's guess. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Revenge Tokyo
episodes.synopsis: After Ryukoh Yanagi escapes from prison, Inspector Sonoda attempts to locate the other death row inmates who wreaked havoc on Tokyo. (Source: Netflix)
